outcome: association between serum AFP levels and placenta accreta
cohort: 504 pregnant women treated between January 1, 2016 and February 28, 2021, including 105 with placenta previa-accreta, 122 with placenta previa, and 277 with healthy pregnancy, matched for BMI.
finding: Elevated second-trimester serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) was positively associated with placenta accreta, suggesting a potential role for AFP in detecting high-risk pregnancies.
